name: Dressing
overview: Scripture instructs believers to approach dressing with reverence and discernment, emphasizing distinctions in gender-specific attire as a matter of obedience to God. Dressing should reflect modesty and humility rather than pride or ostentation, as seen in the caution against haughty behavior and excessive adornment. Furthermore, the principle of faith guides personal choices in dress, warning that actions done in doubt are sinful, thereby encouraging moderation and thoughtful consideration in how one presents oneself before the Lord.
